# OverlayConfig

> **File:** `config/OverlayConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Overlay: the configured views, plus the card grid's layout constants. (Named OverlayConfig because `Overlay` is the module type.)

### Properties

- `views` (readonly var)
- `moduleScale` (readonly int): How much of what fills the screen the overlay's cards take, in %: the card size (Widget.cardSize) times the overlay's own Module size, at most all of it (see layoutFor)
- `size` (readonly int)
- `navigator` (readonly string): The page switcher's edge, "bottom" | "top", and which tabs show their names: "auto" (all while they fit) | "current" | "icons"
- `navigatorLabels` (readonly string)
- `animation` (readonly string): "top" | "bottom" (the edge it slides in from) | "fade"
- `showBackdrop` (readonly bool)
- `backdrop` (readonly real): 0-1 opacity of the backdrop
- `monitors` (readonly string): "general" | "primary" | "focused" | "all" (see General.screensFor)
- `closeOnEscape` (readonly bool)
- `closeOnOutsideClick` (readonly bool)
- `pinnedPages` (readonly var): The pages that aren't in config, after the configured ones: the layouts editor (overlay pages and edge menus), which can't be removed.
- `availableModuleTypes` (readonly var)
- `libraryGroups` (readonly var): The groups the editors' libraries sort bar widgets and modules into (the schema's `x-libraryGroups`), in order
- `customViewSchema` (readonly var): A Custom page's own fields (name, icon, fineGrid), for the layouts editor
- `availableViewTypes` (readonly var)
- `cardSpacing` (readonly int): Card grid layout (see GridPlacement for the geometry).
- `boxPadding` (readonly int): The overlay box's padding around a page (OverlayPages), at the Interface scale: the page inside it is scaled, the box isn't
- `navigatorHeight` (readonly int): The page switcher's height (OverlayPageNavigator), and the room it takes off the pages' area with the gaps around it (OverlayPanel)
- `navigatorRoom` (readonly int)
- `fitCardsWide` (readonly real): At most this many cards fit across, so a page four cards wide still fits a 16:9 screen

### Functions

- `modulesFor(host)`: The module types a host's library offers: "overlay" pages, "edgeMenu"s or the "lockscreen" (required ones are always there)
- `requiredFor(host)`: The required module types on a host
- `isRequired(type)`
- `allowedIn(type, host)`
- `moduleInfo(type)`
- `viewInfo(type)`
- `viewLabel(view, index)`: How a page is named and drawn in the page navigator and the overlay editor: a Custom page by its name (or its place), others by type (i18n: keys from the schema's view labels)
- `pageKey(view)`: What opens a page by name (`openOverlayPage`, a bar Button or bind's `overlayPage` action): a Custom page's name, other pages' type; "" for a Custom page with no name
- `viewIcon(type)`
- `pageIcon(view)`: A page's icon: a Custom page's own, else its type's
- `isTool(type)`
- `pageWithModule(type)`: The page to open for a module type (what openOverlayPage takes): the named Custom page where it's biggest, "" when no page has it
- `cardPad(compact, bare)`: The inner padding a module lays its content out within (Card/Panel `pad`): none when bare, less in a quarter slot (Widget's density)
- `layoutFor(width, height)`: The overlay's cards for `width` × `height` px of room (the page area less its margin and the box's padding): { drawn, unit, zoom }, see GridPlacement.overlayLayout
- `cardUnitOn(width, height)`: The card size (px) every module grid on a `width` × `height` screen starts from: what an overlay at the card size (Widget.cardSize, not the overlay's own Module size) would draw there with no bars, i…
- `screenArrangement(layout, modules, screen, width, height)`: A screen layout's (a DesktopLayout's, the lock screen's, the greeter's) `modules` on `screen` in a `width` × `height` px room (its room inside the bars and border): the units that fit there at its ca…
- `pageUnit(view, unit)`: The card size a Custom page's modules are laid out at on an overlay whose cards are `unit` px: a double grid's (fineGrid) has twice the units across (GridPlacement.fineUnit)
- `span(n, unit)`
- `slotShape(rect)`
- `defaultSize(type)`: The size [w, h] a module is added at: its declared one, else a card.
- `minSize(type)`: The least [w, h] a module dropped into a gap is shrunk to fit it: its declared one, else half its default size.
